source: 645 “Gifts”
target: 645 “Dona”

source: After Louis Berry left the coffee area, Kolobo breathed a sigh of relief.
target: Postquam Louis Berry spatium café reliquit, Kolobo suspirum levationis edidit.

source: He removed his sunglasses, retrieved the 5,000 verl d’or, and counted it again.
target: Oculos solares abstulit, quinque milia “verl d’or” recuperavit, et iterum numeravit.

source: His gut told him this deal would work out.
target: Viscera eius nuntiaverunt ei hoc commercium feliciter eveniturum esse.

source: That’s the only reason he dared to risk coming to the Matani Import and Export Shop.
target: Id sola erat causa cur ausus esset periculum subire ut ad tabernam importationis et exportationis Matani accederet.

source: Still, his whole body had been trembling with fear.
target: Tamen totum corpus eius timore tremuit.

source: He couldn’t even keep his eyes open most of the time, and his hands were shaking so badly that he was surprised it was legible.
target: Non poterat etiam oculos plerumque tenere apertos, et manus eius tantopere tremebant ut miraretur id legibile esse.

source: Trouble always waits until it’s ready to explode, he thought, clutching his sunglasses.
target: Incommodum semper exspectat donec ad erumpendum paratum fuerit, cogitavit, oculos solares tenens.

source: He stood up and headed for the door.
target: Surgens se insurrexit et ad ianuam contulit.

source: Something was wrong.
target: Aliquid male erat.

source: He could feel it.
target: Illud sentire poterat.

source: His body tensed with some kind of danger sense he couldn’t explain.
target: Corpus eius contrahuitur aliquo periculi sensu, quem explicare non poterat.

source: His heart raced as he scanned the place professionally, trying to pinpoint the danger.
target: Cor eius pulsat, dum peritus locum perscrutatus periculi speciem determinare conabatur.

source: Kolobo’s footsteps changed–sometimes fast, sometimes slow.
target: Gradus Kolobo mutantur – aliquando celeres, aliquando tardi.

source: He’d zip off in one direction only to stop short a few paces later.
target: In una directione festinanter se contulit, sed paucis passibus postea subsistere coepit.

source: Kolobo took in the morning sun, the quiet shop that had just opened its doors, and the handful of customers scattered about.
target: Kolobo solem matutinum atque tabernam quietam, quae modo ianuas aperuerat, et paucos clientes circum dispersos observavit.

source: Not a single pair of eyes seemed fixed on him, and there was no one lurking in the shadows, observing his every move.
target: Nulla par oculorum ad eum apposita videbatur, neque quisquam in umbris latens eius singulos motus inspicabat.

source: Yet, following his instincts, his feet carried him back to the coffee shop area. That’s where he finally stopped, in front of the bathroom sign.
target: At vero, instinctus sequentibus, pedes eum ad spatium café reducerunt. Ibi tandem sistit, coram indicato signo latrinarum.

source: Two years as a Beyonder taught Kolobo the most important lesson: trust your gut. Without thinking, he yanked open the heavy wooden door and walked inside.
target: Duo anni ut Beyonder maximum verbum Kolobo docuerunt: fida in tuo instinctu. Sine mora cogitandi, ianuam ligneam gravem evulsit et intravit.

source: The Matani Import and Export Shop wasn’t some back‐alley dive. This restroom was big. Three urinals, three stalls, and gas lamps flickered on the clean tile.
target: Taberna Matani Importationis et Exportationis non erat taberna vilis obscura; haec latrina ampla erat. Tres urinaria, tres cellae, et lumina gasifera in tessera puris micabant.

source: Kolobo headed to the sink to splash cold water on his face. Maybe that would shake this weird danger feeling that was creeping all over him.
target: Kolobo ad lavatorium se contulit ut aquam frigida in faciem effunderet. Forsitan hoc insolitum periculi sensum, quod eum circumibat, exsolvaret.

source: As he looked up, a face stared back at him in the mirror.
target: Cum sursum aspiceret, facies in speculo eius respiciebat.

source: But it wasn’t his.
target: Sed non eius erat.

source: The face was freakishly white. The guy looked late twenties, with light brown skin and eyes that flashed a dark, sickly green. He stared at Kolobo with dead, cold eyes.
target: Facies insolite candida erat. Vir vicesimos annos attigit videbatur, cum cute fulva et oculis obscuro, aegrotoque virentibus; Kolobo eum spectabat oculis mortuis et frigidi.

source: Kolobo’s brain short-circuited as recognition hit.
target: Mens Kolobo simul evanuit, cum recognitio eum percussit.

source: Twanaku Tupián, the only Prisoner pathway Beyonder on their patrol team.
target: Twanaku Tupián, solus Beyonder viae Carcerarii in eorum manipulo praesidii, erat.

source: The guy had become a Sequence 6 Zombie last year.
target: Hic vir anno ultimo Sequenciam VI Zombie factus fuit.

source: He was also the first guy to ever make Kolobo’s skin crawl.
target: Is etiam primus vir fuit qui cutem Kolobo pertremere fecit.

source: If he told anyone else, he gut told him he’d end up dead!
target: Si cuicquam alio dixeret, viscera illi nuntiaverunt eum in fine mortis futurum esse!

source: When Lumian asked Kolobo to spill the beans about the Prisoner pathway Beyonder on his team, something about it felt wrong.
target: Cum Lumian Kolobo rogavit ut de Beyonder viae Carcerarii in sua turma exponeret, aliquid in ea iniuriose videbatur.

source: He’d almost bailed on the whole deal.
target: Paene totum pactum deseruisse velle videbatur.

source: He’d counted that huge 50,000 sum not out of distrust but because he needed time to think, to weigh the risk.
target: Illam magnam summam quinquaginta milia non ex diffidentia sed quia tempus ad cogitandum et periculum aestimandum necessarium habebat, numeravit.

source: He decided to trust his gut, but he hadn’t told Lumian about this feeling, this fear of Tupián…
target: Constituit hisque viscera fidere, sed Lumian de hoc sensu, de hoc Tupián timore nihil dixit.

source: And now, here Twanaku Tupián was, reflected in the mirror.
target: Et nunc, ecce Twanaku Tupián in speculo reflectus erat.

source: This is a Sequence 5 Wraith power.
target: Hoc est vis Umbrarum Sequenciae V.

source: When did he advance?
target: Quando profectus est?

source: Kolobo could barely think over the growing horror.
target: Kolobo vix de creciente horrore cogitare potuit.

source: Suddenly, his body felt like it’d been dropped into an icy lake.
target: Subito corpus eius sensit quasi in lacu glaciali deiectum fuisset.

source: Twanaku Twanaku’s face in the mirror vanished.
target: Facies Twanaku Tupián in speculo evanuit.

source: Kolobo could barely move.
target: Kolobo vix se movere potuit.

source: An icy coldness gripped him, the kind that chilled you to the bone.
target: Frigiditas glacialis eum complexa est, quae ad ossa refrigeraret.

source: It wasn’t his own hands that were moving–they lifted without him wanting them to.
target: Non manus eius movebantur, sed levatae sunt sine eius voluntate.

source: A voice drifted through his ears, flat and emotionless.
target: Vox per aures eius diffusa est, plana et sine affectu.

source: “Looks like my cover is blown. You were actually asked to provide my information.
target: “Videtur tectum meum detegitum esse. Vere petitum est ut notitiam meam praebeatis.”

source: “I’ll get out of Port Pylos, but I’m going to leave two gifts for Lumian Lee.”
target: “Ex Portu Pylos exeiam, sed duo dona Lumian Lee relinquam.”

source: What did that even mean?
target: Quid hoc etiam significabat?

source: What kind of gift?
target: Qualis donum erat?

source: And who the heck was Lumian Lee?
target: Et quis autem erat Lumian Lee?

source: Kolobo’s thoughts were a jumbled mess.
target: Cogitationes Kolobo confusae erant.

source: His own hands were tightening around his neck.
target: Manus eius propriae circum collum stringebantur.

source: Then, with a sickening jolt, he realized what “gift” the voice was talking about.
target: Tum, cum nauseabundo tremore, intellexit de quo “donum” vox loquebatur.

source: Twanaku Tupián was going to kill him and leave a gift–his dead body!
target: Twanaku Tupián eum interficere et donum relinqui – corpus eius mortuum – parabat.

source: But he said two gifts. What was the other one?
target: Sed duo dona dixerat. Quae altera erat?

source: In the four-story beige building of the patrol team.
target: In aedificio quadripartito, colore beige, turmae praesidii.

source: Camus sipped his Highlander coffee and read the West Balam Telegraph, contemplating the deal between Kolobo and Louis Berry.
target: Camus sorbetur suum caffeum Highlander et legit “West Balam Telegraph”, pactum inter Kolobo et Louis Berry meditans.

source: If successful, as an intermediary, he would receive 20% of the amount.
target: Si successerit, ut mediarius, viginti centesimas summae acciperet.

source: Knock, knock, knock.
target: Trepitus, trepitus, trepitus.

source: A gentle rap echoed on Camus’s office door.
target: Mollis pulsus in ianuam officii Camus resonavit.

source: “Please come in.” Though not particularly young, Camus had ample experience, leading one of the patrol team’s operations teams.
target: “Quaeso, intrate.” Quamquam non nimis iuvenis, Camus amplam experientiam habebat, ducem unius turmae operativae gerens.

source: If there were a vacancy for the vice-captain position, his only competition would be Twanaku Tupián of the Prisoner pathway.
target: Si locum viceni capitani vacaret, unica certatio eius esset Twanaku Tupián, Beyonder viae Carcerarii.

source: The Southern Continent was a chaotic place, especially in an area torn between multiple factions.
target: Continentia Meridionalis locus chaos erat, praesertim in regione inter varias factiones divisus.

source: Whether dealing with the bloodthirsty Rose School of Thought, the ominous Numinous Episcopate, ambitious adventurers, spies from various countries, or missionaries, danger lurked at every corner.
target: Sive tractaretur cum sanguinolenta “Rose School of Thought”, sive cum ominoso “Numinous Episcopate”, sive cum ambitiosis advenis, speculatoribus ex variis nationibus, sive cum missionariis, periculum in omnibus angulis latuit.

source: Some would take the initiative to assassinate patrol team members, while others would rebel and escape.
target: Aliqui initium capere ausi sunt ad membra turmae praesidii interficienda, alii autem rebellare et evadere conabantur.

source: Meticulous planning was not uncommon, and even the patrol team members found themselves as targets.
target: Meticulosa consilia non erant insolita, et etiam membra turmae praesidii se tamquam metas inveniebant.

source: Consequently, the patrol team faced casualties every year, leading to a constant need for new recruits.
target: Consequenter, turma praesidii annuo casibus laborabat, quod ad perpetuam necessitatem novorum adtructorum duxit.

source: Encountering more attacks had its advantages.
target: Multos impetus occurrere utilia habebat.

source: Victorious confrontations often yielded valuable items and Beyonder-related ingredients.
target: Confrontationes victores saepe pretiosa obiecta et componentes Beyonder adferre solitae erant.

source: Many of the patrol team’s advancement formulas and potions were acquired in such situations, creating a noteworthy trend.
target: Multae formulae progressionis et pocula turmae praesidii in talibus condicionibus comparatae sunt, efficientes notabilem modum.

source: Compared to cities of similar size in the Northern Continent, Port Pylos had an even greater number of official Beyonders, especially Mid-Sequence Beyonders.
target: Comparata urbibus similis magnitudinis in Continente Septentrionali, Portus Pylos numerum Beyonder officialium etiam maiorem habebat, praesertim Beyonder mediis sequentiis.

source: However, they lacked higher levels of power or corresponding Sealed Artifacts.
target: Attamen gradus potentiae superiores aut artifacta sigillata correspondentes defuerunt.

source: Camus found himself in a tight spot financially due to his rapid advancement outpacing his cousins.
target: Camus in difficultate pecuniaria versabatur, quod celeris ascensio eius cognatos suos superabat.

source: Arriving in Matani State and Port Pylos as a Sequence 9 Arbiter, he had swiftly climbed to a Sequence 7 Justiciar in just five years.
target: Adveniens in Civitate Matani et Portu Pylos ut Arbiter Sequenciae IX, celeriter ad Justiciarium Sequenciae VII pervenit in quinque annis.

source: His goal was to advance to Sequence 6 and become a Judge, and he had recently been gathering the funds to purchase the necessary materials.
target: Propositum eius erat ad Sequenciam VI progredi et Iudicem fieri, et nuper pecunias colligebat ad materias necessarias emendas.

source: If the opportunity to become a vice-captain arose, the patrol team would certainly contribute resources to aid his advancement.
target: Si occasio ad viceni ducis munus oriremur, turma praesidii certe opes ad eius progressionem adiungendam offerret.

source: Spoils of war weren’t always suitable for him; sometimes, he needed to trade with teammates or sell them to the patrol team for money.
target: Praeda belli non semper ei opportuna erat; interdum necesse habebat cum sodalibus commercio uti aut ea turmae praesidii pro pecunia vendere.

source: He patiently waited for the potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients corresponding to his pathway to appear.
target: Clemens exspectabat formulas poculorum et ingredientes Beyonder qui viae eius corresponderent, apparere.

source: The patrol team, being relatively new, hadn’t accumulated substantial reserves.
target: Turma praesidii, nuper condita, copias substantiarum non congregaverat.

source: Camus needed to find a way to purchase practical mystical items, regularly replenish charms, potions, and other essentials to stay prepared against assassinations and conflicts.
target: Camus viam invenire debebat ad res mysticas utiles emendas, ad sigilla, pocula, et alia necessaria regulariter reficienda, ut contra caedes et contentiones paratus maneret.

source: In such a situation, money was naturally scarce.
target: In tali condicione, pecunia naturaliter rara erat.

source: Chaos was a path to hell but also a ladder to the top!
target: Chaos via ad inferos erat, sed etiam scala ad summum!

source: Pugilist Sow entered.
target: Pugil Sow intravit.

source: With his brown braids gently swaying, Sow, clad in a sky-blue shirt and beige pants, approached Camus with one hand in his pocket, smiling as he asked, “Have you seen Kolobo? I need to discuss something with him.”
target: Cum trichis fusci modice undantibus, Sow, indutus camisia caeli caerulei et braccis beige, accedebat ad Camus una manu in sinu posita, subridens quaerens: “Kolobone vidisti? Aliquid cum eo disserere mihi oportet.”

source: Camus had already prepared a reason.
target: Camus iam causam praeparaverat.

source: “He went to the Import and Export Shop to buy coffee beans.”
target: “Ad Tabernam Importationis et Exportationis ivit ad emendum granos café.”

source: Sow tersely acknowledged, “Then I’ll wait for him to return.”
target: Sow breviter respondit: “Tum exspectabo ut redeat.”

source: “What’s up?” Camus asked casually.
target: “Quid agitur?” Camus leviter quaesivit.

source: Sow took two steps forward and smiled.
target: Sow duos passus progressus est et subridit.

source: “There’s an investigation we would like to involve him in. Maybe he can uncover clues that others can’t.”
target: “Investigatio est in qua eum implicare velimus. Forsitan indicia detegere possit quae alii non possunt.”

source: “You bastards, aren’t you concerned about Kolobo getting hurt?” Camus replied with amusement, lifting his coffee and taking a sip.
target: “Vobis, improbi, nonne cura est de Kolobo laedendo?” Camus iocose respondit, caffeum levans et sorbillans.

source: At that moment, Sow withdrew his right hand from his trouser pocket, holding a poker card flickering with a metallic gleam between his thumb and index finger.
target: Illo momento, Sow dexteram manum ex sinu bracae extraxit, tenens chartam ludi poker, inter pollicem et indicem, metallum micantem.

source: The card portrayed a grayish-white clown.
target: Charta scurram cinereo-albidam repraesentabat.

source: With a swift motion, Sow hurled the poker card at Camus’s head.
target: Celeri motu, Sow chartam poker ad caput Camus iaculatus est.

source: In the men’s washroom of the Matani Import and Export Shop.
target: In latrina virorum Tabernae Matani Importationis et Exportationis.

source: Kolobo finally caught his reflection in the mirror.
target: Kolobo tandem imaginem suam in speculo cepit.

source: His skin had turned a sickly green, and his hands were locked around his own neck, the pressure making his bones crack.
target: Cutis eius viridi aegroto facta erat, et manus eius circum collum suum constringebantur, pressio ossa eius concidens.

source: Twanaku Tupián stared back at him from his bright blue eyes.
target: Twanaku Tupián ex oculis caeruleis splendentibus eum inspiciebat.

source: Kolobo tried to scream, but nothing came out.
target: Kolobo clamare conatus est, sed nihil effluere potuit.

source: He wanted to run, but his legs wouldn’t move.
target: Currere vellebat, sed crura eius movere non poterant.

source: It was like his body wasn’t his anymore—it was killing him.
target: Quasi corpus eius non esset eius; eum interficiebat.

source: Ugh… A choked sound finally escaped Kolobo’s throat, too quiet for anyone to hear.
target: Heu… Sonus suffocatus tandem ex gutture Kolobo evasit, nimis quietus ut quis audiret.

source: Fear and despair tightened around his heart.
target: Timor et desperatio circa cor eius stringebantur.

source: Then, Kolobo’s fingers slipped.
target: Tum digiti Kolobo lapsi sunt.

source: A figure emerged from the shadows by the bathroom vents.
target: Figura ex umbris iuxta foramina latrinarum apparuit.

source: Lumian—black hair, green eyes, all dressed in black and white with a golden straw hat.
target: Lumian — capillis nigris, oculis viridibus, totus in nigro ac albo indutus, cum pileo stramineo aureo.

source: A flicker of surprise crossed his face, then understanding.
target: Exsurrectio admirationis per faciem eius transiit, deinde intellectus.

source: He held a black bone flute to his lips.
target: Fistulam ossis nigri ad labia tenebat.

source: A hum resounded, accompanied by a melancholic tune echoing from the dark red holes.
target: Humitus resonabat, comitatus cantu melancholico ex foraminibus rubris tenebris sonantibus.

source: Symphony of Hatred!
target: Symphonia Odii!

source: Why did I only sense malice and danger now…
target: Cur nunc solum malitiam et periculum sentio…

source: Just as this thought crossed Twanaku’s mind, Twanaku’s murderous intent exploded, fueled by the haunting melody.
target: Justum ut haec cogitatio in mentem Twanaku pervenit, ejus intentio homicida subito floruit, a melodia obsessa alita.

source: Silently, a figure peeled away from Kolobo’s body.
target: Silentio, figura a corpore Kolobo se dislocavit.

source: It was Twanaku Tupián, his light brown skin gone deathly pale.
target: Erat Twanaku Tupián, cuius cutis fusca in pallorem mortiferum versa erat.

source: Blood vessels bulged in his yellow eyes, threatening to burst.
target: Vasa sanguinea in oculis eius flavis prolabebantur, minantia erumpere.

source: The Symphony of Hatred tore into Kolobo, already weak with fear.
target: Symphonia Odii in Kolobo irrupit, iam timore debilis.

source: His heart almost stopped.
target: Cor eius paene cessavit.

source: He crumpled to the floor, barely alive.
target: In terram collapsus est, vix superstes.

source: Lumian stopped the melody. Holding the black bone flute, he slid back into the shadows and under the vent.
target: Lumian melodiem sistit. Fistulam ossis nigri tenens, in umbras atque sub foramina redactus est.

source: A moment later, he reappeared behind Twanaku Tupián, who was practically vibrating with murderous intent.
target: Momento post, iterum apparuit post Twanaku Tupián, qui fere cum homicida intentio vibrabat.

source: Lumian lifted the flute, its blood-colored holes gleaming ominously, and took a breath.
target: Lumian fistulam levavit, foraminibus sanguine coloratis minaciter micantibus, et spiritum traxit.

source: Finally, you’re here!
target: Denique, hic es!
